sourceProjection.basis: The sculpture-floor and garden diagram is an overhead plan with repeated aligned room boundaries. Curved exterior landscaping is not interpreted as perspective distortion.

review: Physical page 10 visually inspected. Orthographic sculpture-floor plan. Visible filled paths 53/60/61/62/65 are structural masonry with door gaps. Paths 63-67 and 81-162 are terrace, garden and stair detail, retained flat. Stair pictogram 54-59 is a symbol rather than its physical geometry. The second duplicated drawing stream is outside its clipping path and is not used. Roman room numerals I-VIII retained directly from text anchors. Exhibition hatching is not a wall or a current artwork position.
limitations: 本图覆盖雕塑层 I–VIII 厅、中央大厅、门廊及相邻花园；上层绘画馆平面资料尚待补齐。
建筑平面依据馆方专题展资料；不将当时的临时展品位置当作当前陈列。
原图只提供楼梯符号，未绘制上层落点，不生成跨层连线。
